news.headline: Career Services Making Students Future-Ready November 5, 2021 4 min read

paragraphs: Potential.ly sells a platform that universities and learning organisations use to connect learning outcomes with evidence of competency. The pages describe portfolio assessment, AI-powered skills capture and longitudinal analytics as the parts of that platform. Buyers are addressed by role, with sections for teaching and learning leaders, for student success and engagement, and for career services leaders.

Institution-wide engagement and awards programmes track student development from pre-arrival through graduation. The case studies page describes integrations with other university systems such as SSO, Canvas, Blackboard and Zoom. That page names Loughborough University, University College Cork and Cardiff University as institutions it has written up.

Beyond higher education, the platform is also offered to membership organisations, SMEs and professional training providers. A continuing professional development platform is offered for academic staff and for professional learners across education and enterprise.

quote.text: Make Learning Visible. Make Skills Verifiable.
